Messages.Author: JDS
Messages.Body:
While a Malkavian is using the Madness Network ability during someone else's
turn, can other minions the Meth. with the Madness Network controls play
reaction cards?
Thanks,
Dave

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Assuming you mean: "can other minions controlled by the controlled
of the acting Malkavian play reaction cards?"

No. Reaction cards can only be played to react to the action of another
Methuselah's minion. [RTR 970630]
